unit_label: BRBL C U06: Calculate a bounded borrower appeal deposit after choosing the correct base

facts.statement: Borrower deposit ordinarily50% of lower creditor claim/DRT debt; written-reason reduction cannot fall below25% of same base. Calculation does not establish entitlement to reduction.

facts.locator: printed pp.269-279 / PDF pp.288-298, whole unit and end questions visually inspected
facts.statement: Courseware outlines enforcement; older redemption wording and placement of management restrictions reconciled against amended primary text rather than repeated.

payload.title: Choose the debt base before the percentage
payload.core_explanation_md: Assume an otherwise maintainable borrower appeal under section18, creditor claim INR 920,000 and DRT-determined debt INR 760,000. Calculate the ordinary 50% deposit. No reduction has been granted.

self_check.prompt_text: Which legal premises were stipulated rather than proved by arithmetic?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Eligibility, applicable statutory route and any discretionary order are assumed in the question; arithmetic does not establish them.

payload.stem_md: Assume an otherwise maintainable borrower section18 appeal, creditor claim INR 1,260,000 and DRT-determined debt INR 980,000. No reduction order exists. Calculate the ordinary 50% deposit in exact INR.

numeric_rule.rounding_instruction: Use exact whole rupees with no intermediate rounding.

payload.stem_md: For a bounded section18 calculation, assume claim INR 1,540,000 and DRT-determined debt INR 1,200,000. The Tribunal grants a reasoned reduction to the statutory minimum 25% of the specified base. Calculate that deposit in exact INR. The question stipulates the order, rather than predicting a reduction.
payload.correct_explanation_md: Choose min(1540000,1200000)=1200000 INR; the stipulated 25% deposit is 300000 INR.

numeric_rule.rounding_instruction: Use exact whole rupees with no intermediate rounding.
